title: People’s Mañanera October 29
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Tribute to Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas: Sovereignty, Justice, and Struggle  
** Following the news of the death of Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas, President Claudia
Sheinbaum honored his legacy of resistance to neoliberalism. From the fight
against electoral fraud in 1988 to the popular victory at the polls in 1997,
Cárdenas paved the way for “democracy from below,” with the people in power.

**Housing for Well-being: 448 Homes for Families in Pátzcuaro  
** Through a lottery, the National Housing Commission (CONAVI) allocated homes
to 1,307 applicants, 77% of whom were women, as part of the Michoacán Plan for
Peace and Justice. The first homes are expected to be delivered by the end of
the year.

**INE: Auditing the Past and Ending the “Coyotes”, Corrupt Intermediaries  
** Guadalupe Taddei who recently resigned as president of the National
Electoral Institute (INE) betrayed the trust of the Mexican people, Sheinbaum
said. She demanded a review of contracts, trusts, and privileges dating from
various presidential administrations. Talleres Gráficos will produce election
materials at lower costs and with greater transparency.

**García Luna Case: Recovery of Nearly 200 Million Pesos (US$10.64 million)  
** Sheinbaum highlighted the work of Pablo Gómez at the Financial Intelligence
Unit. Gómez explained that the institution blocks financial transactions using
a watchlist and strengthens efforts to prevent money laundering.
